title: Man Impales Girlfriend With Spear During Drunken Fight
description:
Bodycam footage shows the final moments before a deadly domestic dispute in Broward County, Florida. Police responded to the apartment of Adam Crespo and Sylvia Galva after a friend called 911 reporting severe injuries. Officers arrived to find Galva impaled through the chest by a spear-like decorative bedpost. Crespo claimed the injury was an accident during an argument, but investigators and medical experts determined the wound required significant force and was consistent with homicide. Crespo later pleaded no contest to second-degree murder and was sentenced to life in prison. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
